description: This Java class, LoanChargeApiJsonValidator, provides validation methods for JSON payloads related to loan charges in a financial application. It validates input data for adding, updating, refunding, and adjusting loan charges, ensuring data integrity and adherence to business rules. The class relies on a helper for JSON parsing and validation, and integrates with domain repositories to validate charge-related references.

classes.name: LoanChargeApiJsonValidator
classes.description: A validation component for loan charge JSON payloads, ensuring correct and consistent data before processing loan charges.

methods.name: validateAddLoanCharge
methods.description: Validates JSON input for adding a new loan charge, checking required fields and correct data types.

methods.name: validateUpdateOfLoanCharge
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing loan charge.

methods.name: validateChargePaymentTransaction
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for a loan charge payment transaction, with optional inclusion of charge ID.

methods.name: validateLoanChargeRefundTransaction
methods.description: Validates JSON input for a loan charge refund transaction.

methods.name: validateLoanChargeAdjustmentRequest
methods.description: Validates JSON for requesting an adjustment to a loan charge.

methods.name: validateInstallmentChargeTransaction
methods.description: Validates JSON for a transaction related to an installment charge.

methods.name: validateLoanCharges
methods.description: Validates a set of loan charges against business rules and currency consistency.

methods.name: validateLoanCharges
methods.description: Validates a JSON element representing loan charges against loan product and business rules.

methods.name: validateInterestBearingLoanProductRestriction
methods.description: Checks restrictions specific to interest-bearing loan products when applying charges.
